data.narrative:
Hermeus is a Series C-stage company operating in the Supersonic & Hypersonic sector, backed by founders AJ Piplica, Skyler Shuford, Glenn Case, and Mike Smayda. The company currently carries a $1.0B post-money valuation following $500M in total capital raised. The peer universe in this sector remains sparse: two public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and one private peer (Boom Supersonic) were identified, limiting the depth of benchmarking analysis.

Given the thinly populated comparable set, stage-progression methodology emerged as the only reliable triangulation method. Applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier—standard for Series C-to-next-stage transitions—to the $1.0B current post-money valuation yields an implied value of $1.7B. This single-method result anchors the mid-point of the valuation range.

The analysis supports a range of $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median point of $1.7B. The wide band reflects methodology limitations rather than analytical precision: the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers in Supersonic & Hypersonic prevents peer-median cross-validation, leaving stage progression as the sole quantitative anchor. Key uncertainties include the applicability of standard venture step-up multiples to a capital-intensive, regulatory-dependent sector, and the representativeness of the sparse public comparables for a private frontier-tech business at this development stage.
